block.description: The TerraCurl provider allows you to make custom HTTP requests in Terraform.

ca_cert_directory.description: Path to a directory on local disk that contains one or more certificate files that will be used to validate the certificate presented by the server

ca_cert_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that will be used to validate the certificate presented by the server

cert_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that contains the PEM-encoded certificate to present to the server

destroy_ca_cert_directory.description: Path to a directory on local disk that contains one or more certificate files that will be used to validate the certificate presented by the server for the destroy call

destroy_ca_cert_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that will be used to validate the certificate presented by the server for the destroy call

destroy_cert_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that contains the PEM-encoded certificate to present to the server for the destroy call

destroy_headers.description: Map of headers to attach to the destroy API call

destroy_key_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that contains the PEM-encoded private key for which the authentication certificate was issued for the destroy call

destroy_max_retry.description: Maximum number of tries until it is marked as failed for the destroy call

destroy_method.description: Destroy HTTP method to use in the API call

destroy_request_body.description: A request body to attach to the destroy API call

destroy_request_parameters.description: Map of parameters to attach to the destroy API call

destroy_request_url_string.description: Destroy request URL includes parameters if request specified

destroy_response_codes.description: A list of expected response codes for the destroy call

destroy_retry_interval.description: Interval between each attempt for the destroy call

destroy_skip_tls_verify.description: Set this to true to disable verification of the server's TLS certificate for the destroy call

destroy_timeout.description: Time in seconds before each request times out for the destroy call. Defaults to 10

drift_marker.description: Marker to track state drift and trigger resource replacement

headers.description: Map of headers to attach to the API call

ignore_response_fields.description: List of JSON fields to ignore during drift detection.

key_file.description: Path to a file on local disk that contains the PEM-encoded private key for which the authentication certificate was issued

max_retry.description: Maximum number of tries until it is marked as failed

method.description: HTTP method to use in the API call

name.description: Friendly name for this API call

read_ca_cert_directory.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for the read request (TLS).

read_ca_cert_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for the read request (TLS).

read_cert_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded certificate for the read request (TLS).

read_headers.description: Map of headers for the read request.

read_key_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded private key for the read request (TLS).

read_method.description: HTTP method for reading resource state. Required if `skip_read` is false.

read_parameters.description: Optional request parameters to add to the URL

read_request_body.description: Optional request body to use for the read request.

read_response_codes.description: Expected response codes for the read request. Required if `skip_read` is false.

read_skip_tls_verify.description: Skip TLS verification for the read request.

read_url.description: API endpoint for reading resource state. Required if `skip_read` is false.

request_body.description: A request body to attach to the API call

request_parameters.description: Map of parameters to attach to the API call

request_url_string.description: Request URL includes parameters if request specified

response_codes.description: A list of expected response codes

skip_destroy.description: Set this to true to skip issuing a request when the resource is being destroyed

skip_read.description: Set to true to skip the read operation (no drift detection). Defaults to true.

skip_tls_verify.description: Set this to true to disable verification of the server's TLS certificate

status_code.description: Response status code received from request

timeout.description: Time in seconds before each request times out. Defaults to 10
